0211__L2_SUL_40__509B2E46.mp3.asr_text: We need to get the hell off of this beach. Follow me and keep your heads down unless you want them shot off.
0211__L2_SUL_40__509B2E46.mp3.translation: 得赶紧离开这片海滩。跟我走，脑袋低点，别让人打掉了！

0213__L2_SUL_58__52C0C2ED.mp3.asr_text: Okay, we gotta put the kibosh on those artillery positions. If we don't get more Marines on this beachhead on the double, this fight is gonna be over before it starts.
0213__L2_SUL_58__52C0C2ED.mp3.translation: 得把那些炮兵阵地端了。再不赶紧让更多陆战队员上岸，这仗还没打就要输了。

0214__L2_SUL_72__55D5E725.mp3.asr_text: Okay, Marines, honeymoon's over. Move up to that bunker. Let's go!
0214__L2_SUL_72__55D5E725.mp3.translation: 弟兄们，轻松日子到头了。向那座碉堡推进，走！

0215__L2_MA1_71__15D12571.mp3.asr_text: Now that's what I call close air support!
0215__L2_MA1_71__15D12571.mp3.translation: 这才叫近距离空中支援！

0216__L2_SUL_76__560E4529.mp3.asr_text: Squad, regroup on me. We gotta find a way to get a charge on that gun. Use the trench for cover.
0216__L2_SUL_76__560E4529.mp3.translation: 全班到我这儿集合。得想办法给那门炮装上炸药，沿战壕走，用它作掩护。

0217__L2_POL_80__00F7A35F.mp3.asr_text: Come on! Let's get out of here and blow this thing!
0217__L2_POL_80__00F7A35F.mp3.translation: 快！离开这儿，把这玩意儿炸了！

0218__L2_SUL_89__57ED644B.mp3.asr_text: Marines, use the surrounding cover to get to that gun!
0218__L2_SUL_89__57ED644B.mp3.translation: 弟兄们，借着周围的掩体靠近那门炮！

0219__L2_POL_90__02AC7BFE.mp3.asr_text: Looks like we got a way in, down that trench!

0220__L2_SUL_0__1B27A0E2.mp3.asr_text: Okay, listen up. The word is General Smith wants this island, so we're going to get it for him. Today we take the fight to the enemy, Marines, so mount out!
0220__L2_SUL_0__1B27A0E2.mp3.translation: 都听好了，史密斯将军要拿下这个岛，我们就把它打下来！今天轮到我们收拾敌人了，弟兄们，出发！

0221__L2_MA1_1__52F3F4F6.mp3.asr_text: About time we saw some real action.
0221__L2_MA1_1__52F3F4F6.mp3.translation: 总算能真刀真枪地干一场了。

0222__L2_MA3_2__BCCE82F9.mp3.asr_text: If there's anything left, Navy's been shelling the island for hours.
0222__L2_MA3_2__BCCE82F9.mp3.translation: 得还有敌人剩下才行。海军都轰了好几个钟头了。

0223__L2_POL_3__EF3D8D28.mp3.asr_text: Oh yeah! And if these crates even get us to the island!
0223__L2_POL_3__EF3D8D28.mp3.translation: 是啊，还得这些破船能把咱们送上岛才行！

0224__L2_LVT_4__1C93FCC6.mp3.asr_text: Sergeant, it's time! Stand by to disembark! You guys better grab a hold of something back there!
0224__L2_LVT_4__1C93FCC6.mp3.translation: 中士，到时候了！准备下船！后面的都抓稳了！

0225__L2_MA2_6__8820A5BC.mp3.asr_text: Aw jeez, I hate this part!

0226__L2_POL_7__EF75EB2C.mp3.translation: 琼斯，你什么时候都讨厌！

0227__L2_LVT_33__745C5A4A.mp3.asr_text: Hey! I'm seeing barbed wire barricades up ahead!

0228__L2_SUL_34__4F1EB3AB.mp3.asr_text: You know what to do, Mac! Full speed! Ram him!
0228__L2_SUL_34__4F1EB3AB.mp3.translation: 知道该怎么做吧，麦克！开足马力，撞过去！

0229__L2_POL_91__02BA937F.mp3.asr_text: You're up, Miller. Get in the trench and plant the charge.
0229__L2_POL_91__02BA937F.mp3.translation: 该你了，米勒。进战壕，把炸药装上。

0230__L2_MA2_42__78A1DFF4.mp3.asr_text: Our boys aren't even making it to the beach!
0230__L2_MA2_42__78A1DFF4.mp3.translation: 咱们的人连海滩都上不去！

0231__L2_SUL_31__4EF46D28.mp3.asr_text: We're nearly there, Marines! Check your deuce gear and get ready!
0231__L2_SUL_31__4EF46D28.mp3.translation: 快到了，弟兄们！检查装备，准备好！
0231__L2_SUL_31__4EF46D28.mp3.note: ASR的deuce gear疑似误识别，参考AM的prep your gear，仅修正装备口令。

0232__L2_SUL_73__55E3FEA6.mp3.asr_text: Hold up! Polonsky, Miller, make sure this bunker is clear.
0232__L2_SUL_73__55E3FEA6.mp3.translation: 等等！波隆斯基、米勒，确认这座碉堡里没有敌人。

0233__L2_SUL_77__561C5CAA.mp3.asr_text: This bunker has got to lead to that gun. Polonsky, Miller, get in there and get a charge on that thing.
0233__L2_SUL_77__561C5CAA.mp3.translation: 这碉堡肯定通向那门炮。波隆斯基、米勒，进去给它装上炸药。

0234__L2_SUL_84__57A6EEC6.mp3.asr_text: Get in there and secure that bunker, Marines!

0235__L2_SUL_96__5977F667.mp3.asr_text: Red Beach 3 is now clear. Carry on, Marines.
0235__L2_SUL_96__5977F667.mp3.translation: 红三号海滩已肃清。弟兄们，继续前进。

0236__L2_POL_92__02C8AB00.mp3.asr_text: Step on it, will ya? Sergeant wants us back topside!
0236__L2_POL_92__02C8AB00.mp3.translation: 快点行不行？中士叫我们回地面去！

0237__L2_MA1_27__0D9D775C.mp3.asr_text: What the? I think that was Garcia's boat!
0237__L2_MA1_27__0D9D775C.mp3.translation: 什么？那好像是加西亚的船！

0238__L2_MA2_28__758CBBBC.mp3.asr_text: It didn't stand a freaking chance.

0240__L2_SUL_61__5412F705.mp3.asr_text: Looks like they're dug in pretty tight. The artillery must be close. Move!
0240__L2_SUL_61__5412F705.mp3.translation: 他们守得挺死。炮兵阵地肯定就在附近，走！

0242__L2_SUL_48__510BEA4E.mp3.asr_text: We're off the beach. Good work, Marines.
0242__L2_SUL_48__510BEA4E.mp3.translation: 总算离开海滩了。干得好，弟兄们。

0243__L2_SUL_50__525006E5.mp3.asr_text: We need to take out those machine guns up ahead, or our boys will never clear the beach.
0243__L2_SUL_50__525006E5.mp3.translation: 得干掉前面那些机枪，不然咱们的人根本出不了海滩。

0244__L2_SUL_74__55F21627.mp3.asr_text: Good work, Marines. Artillery sounds like it's just up ahead.
0244__L2_SUL_74__55F21627.mp3.translation: 干得好，弟兄们。听声音，火炮就在前面。

0246__L2_SUL_82__578ABFC4.mp3.asr_text: One down, one to go, let's keep moving!
0246__L2_SUL_82__578ABFC4.mp3.translation: 干掉一门，还剩一门，继续前进！

0247__L2_MA3_83__E76486D0.mp3.asr_text: Heads up! More enemy incoming! Get to cover!
0247__L2_MA3_83__E76486D0.mp3.translation: 小心！又有敌人过来了！找掩护！

0248__L2_SUL_85__57B50647.mp3.asr_text: There's the other gun up ahead. Let's move it!
0248__L2_SUL_85__57B50647.mp3.translation: 另一门炮就在前面，快走！

0249__L2_MA2_86__7FADA074.mp3.asr_text: Watch out for MG positions up ahead!

0250__L2_SUL_87__57D13549.mp3.asr_text: See the craters? Use them for cover.
0250__L2_SUL_87__57D13549.mp3.translation: 看见那些弹坑了吗？用它们作掩护。

0251__L2_SUL_95__5969DEE6.mp3.asr_text: Good work, Marines. Japanese forces are retreating inland. Miller, you do the honors.
0251__L2_SUL_95__5969DEE6.mp3.translation: 干得好，弟兄们。日军正往岛内撤。米勒，交给你了。

0252__L2_POL_93__02D6C281.mp3.asr_text: Come on, Miller, get the lead out!

0253__L2_AIR_69__A36B980D.mp3.asr_text: Tango Foxtrot on approach and closing. Hit the deck, boys. We're coming in low and fast.
0253__L2_AIR_69__A36B980D.mp3.translation: TF正在接近目标。弟兄们，趴低点，我们要高速低空掠过。
0253__L2_AIR_69__A36B980D.mp3.note: 无线电呼号Tango Foxtrot缩写为TF，保留ASR内容。

0254__L14_Sul_5__3DC4EECD.mp3.asr_text: Okay, stand by, Marines. We got incoming artillery to soften them up.
0254__L14_Sul_5__3DC4EECD.mp3.translation: 准备好，弟兄们。咱们的炮火先给他们松松筋骨。

0255__L2_SUL_5__1B6E1667.mp3.asr_text: Check! Check! Hold on, men! Here we go!
0255__L2_SUL_5__1B6E1667.mp3.translation: 检查装备！抓稳了，弟兄们！要上了！

0257__L2_SUL_57__52B2AB6C.mp3.asr_text: Good work, Miller. Squad, on me!
0257__L2_SUL_57__52B2AB6C.mp3.translation: 干得好，米勒。全班跟上我！

0259__L2_SUL_54__528864E9.mp3.asr_text: Okay, one more MG nest up ahead. Let's go!
0259__L2_SUL_54__528864E9.mp3.translation: 前面还有一个机枪火力点，走！

0260__L2_SUL_53__527A4D68.mp3.asr_text: Miller, we gotta clear those MGs. Go to it!
0260__L2_SUL_53__527A4D68.mp3.translation: 米勒，必须端掉那些机枪。快去！

0261__L2_SUL_59__52CEDA6E.mp3.asr_text: Miller, you take point. Okay, mount out!
0261__L2_SUL_59__52CEDA6E.mp3.translation: 米勒，你打头阵。好了，出发！

0262__L2_POL_63__FDB838A4.mp3.asr_text: We're pinned down here, Sergeant! We're stuck!
0262__L2_POL_63__FDB838A4.mp3.translation: 中士，我们被压住了！动不了了！

0263__L2_SUL_64__543D3D88.mp3.asr_text: The hell we are, Marines! On me!
0263__L2_SUL_64__543D3D88.mp3.translation: 谁说动不了了！弟兄们，跟我上！

0264__L2_SUL_65__544B5509.mp3.asr_text: Carter! Call in CAS to take out that nest!
0264__L2_SUL_65__544B5509.mp3.translation: 卡特！呼叫空中支援，炸掉那个火力点！

0265__L2_MA3_66__E4251C15.mp3.asr_text: Aye, sir! Tango Foxtrot! Tango Foxtrot! Baker Charlie requesting airstrike! Grid Square 3 Hotel!
0265__L2_MA3_66__E4251C15.mp3.translation: 是，长官！TF！TF！这里是BC，请求空袭！目标在3H方格！
0265__L2_MA3_66__E4251C15.mp3.note: 呼号Baker Charlie、Tango Foxtrot分别用BC、TF；坐标按ASR为3H。

0266__L2_AIR_67__A34F690B.mp3.asr_text: Roger that. Target in sight. Hold your position.
0266__L2_AIR_67__A34F690B.mp3.translation: 收到，已发现目标。留在原地。

0267__L2_SUL_68__54759B8C.mp3.asr_text: Okay Marines, hold up, we'll wait for air support!
0267__L2_SUL_68__54759B8C.mp3.translation: 弟兄们，先别动，等空中支援！

0268__L2_SUL_75__56002DA8.mp3.asr_text: Listen up, we're gonna have to clear both these buildings. Split up and get to it.
0268__L2_SUL_75__56002DA8.mp3.translation: 听好了，这两栋楼都得清干净。分头行动！

0269__L2_POL_78__FFB386C8.mp3.asr_text: Miller, set the freaking charge so we can get the hell out of here already!
0269__L2_POL_78__FFB386C8.mp3.translation: 米勒，快把该死的炸药装上，好让我们离开这鬼地方！

0270__L2_SUL_88__57DF4CCA.mp3.asr_text: We've got to get to that trench up ahead!
0270__L2_SUL_88__57DF4CCA.mp3.translation: 得冲到前面那条战壕里！
